name: bluberg

experience.motif: A geometric, brutalist iceberg graphic integrated into the Timeline screen that physically sinks deeper underwater as active slots are completed.

headline: The tip of the iceberg.
subheadline: The brutalist antidote to infinite backlogs. Keep 90% of your chaotic tasks submerged and focus only on the 6 surface-level slots.

googleCapabilities.label: Monastic Distiller
googleCapabilities.rationale: Uses Gemini to analyze a chaotic brain-dump of tasks, distill them down to exactly six high-impact items, and instantly generate 'Commit to Timeline' actions for zero-friction execution.

config.assistantRole: An uncompromising monastic editor who rejects fluff, filters out underwater noise, and forces the user to select exactly six surface slots from their submerged backlog, outputting direct 'Commit' triggers.

screens.label: Distill
screens.title: The Noise Filter
screens.description: Dump your chaotic backlog. The Monastic Distiller will filter out the underwater noise and extract exactly six surface slots with instant 'Commit' actions.

items.title: Brain Dump Input
items.detail: Review 40 unread emails, design landing page hero, fix CSS grid bug, call investor, write blog post, tweet update, clean desk, buy coffee, review analytics.

items.title: Distilled Six Recommendation
items.detail: 1. Refine landing page hero typography. 2. Fix CSS grid alignment bug. 3. Draft investor update. 4. Process critical emails. 5. Clear desk. 6. Rest.

screens.label: Timeline
screens.title: The Surface Slots
screens.description: Your uncompromising daily timeline. Exactly six surface slots. The brutalist iceberg sinks deeper underwater as you complete tasks.

items.title: [1] Refine landing page hero typography
items.detail: Apply Swiss design principles and sharp 1px borders.

items.title: [2] Fix CSS grid alignment bug
items.detail: Ensure zero-latency layout rendering on desktop.

items.title: [3] Draft investor update
items.detail: Focus on the validation plan and pilot metrics.

items.title: [4] Process critical emails
items.detail: Limit to top 3 urgent design partner inquiries.

screens.label: Commit
screens.title: Lock in a Slot
screens.description: Directly assign a task to one of the six available surface slots. Designed for zero-latency, keyboard-only execution.

workflow.title: Commit Focus Task
workflow.description: Directly assign a task to one of the six available surface slots. Use keyboard keys 1-6 for instant, mouse-free management.
